acceptanceCriteria: work-item new and start reject an archived Work Item that lacks a valid close decision, without rewriting the archived bytes
status exposes a deterministic readyOnBase/readiness projection and never claims ready when unresolved archived closure, active work, dirty changes, detached branch, or unknown base facts remain
start rejects non-governance changes already present before start and records the exact reason without rejecting repository-owned protocol writes

when a discoverable remote default ref exists, start rejects a branch HEAD that is ahead of or diverged from that declared base; when metadata is unavailable readiness is unknown and no green readiness claim is emitted
two isolated repositories can start independently and all lifecycle entry checks remain repository-scoped with no process-global current project
three-language documentation and CLI regressions describe the entry gate, readiness states, and recovery action
goal: Make close-before-next-start and clean-base entry fail closed without introducing global repository state or weakening repositories that lack discoverable remote metadata.
intent: Prevent lifecycle entry from starting new governed work while the repository has unresolved archived Work Items or unreviewed pre-start changes, and expose an explicit readiness projection for the next Work Item.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the lifecycle entry regression tests and inspect that archived bytes remain unchanged.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the local-only fixture regression and inspect the readiness projection.
